title: Move Zeroes
description: Given an integer array `nums`, move all 0's to the end of it while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements in-place.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
output_format: Space-separated array elements after moving zeroes.

sample_tests.explanation: Non-zero order preserved, zeroes moved to end.

hints: Use a write pointer starting at index 0.
Iterate through the array and whenever a non-zero element is seen, place it at write pointer.
Fill all remaining positions with zeroes.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    non_zeros = [x for x in nums if x != 0]
    zeros = [0] * (n - len(non_zeros))
    print(' '.join(map(str, non_zeros + zeros)))
